newsitem.title: UK: FirstBus, Natl Express in Central Train race.
newsitem.headline: FirstBus, Natl Express in Central Train race.

text.p: Britain's rail franchising agency on Thursday put a FirstBus Plc venture and National Express Group Plc on the final shortlist of bidders for the Central Trains Ltd franchise.

The Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) said the two bidders would be invited to meet members of the West Midlands Passenger Transport Authority, whose executive would be co-signatory to the franchise agreement.
The FirstBus venture, Straightforward Lines Ltd, is 75-percent held by the transport group, with the rest owned by the franchise's management team.
No details of the value of the bids was disclosed.
Central Trains, based in Birmingham, operates passenger services covering central England and extending into Wales and East Anglia.
Earlier, OPRAF named Great Western Holdings, which is 24.5 percent owned by FirstBus, as the preferred bidder for another franchise, North West Regional Railways Ltd.
FirstBus shares rose 12.5p to close at about 239.5, while National Express gained 26p to end at 549.5.
